item.title: Oxford BioDynamics takes prostate cancer test to UAE via Dubai partnership
item.summary: Oxford BioDynamics has signed a partnership to offer its EpiSwitch PSE prostate cancer test across the United Arab Emirates, its first commercial deal for the test in the Gulf.
